name: pnp-powerplatform-prompts-weekly-kpi-digest-dataverse
title: Weekly KPI Digest from Dataverse
shortDescription: Scheduled Power Automate flow that queries Dataverse for weekly sales data, calculates KPIs, and sends an HTML summary email via Outlook every Monday morning.
longDescription: This Power Automate prompt generates a Monday morning KPI digest: it queries Dataverse for sales opportunities closed in the past 7 days, calculates total revenue, deal count, win/loss ratio, and average deal size, formats results as an HTML email with a summary table, and sends it to a distribution list via Outlook. Handles the empty-data edge case with a shorter notification. First prompt in the repository to target Dataverse for scheduled reporting.

metadata.value: Build a scheduled workflow that queries Dataverse for weekly sales KPIs and sends an HTML digest email via Outlook every Monday.
